tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page ground behind the globe, and the paper the globe's halftone is printed on. By night it is blue-black paper.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Surfaces that sit on the paper: the ticket, airport tags, round buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, borders, the route line, coastlines and the globe's outline. Reads on paper and paper-raised in both themes (11:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: city names, distances. On paper and paper-raised only (5.7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Faint marks: the graticule, the dotted ground track under a route, the hover ring. Never text.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: Ocean halftone ink. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: sea-deep
tokens.usage: Water-lining: the engraved ripple lines off the coasts. A mark on paper (3:1 or better), never body text.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Land halftone ink, first pass. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Land second pass, printed slightly out of register. By day it deepens the shadow side; by night it lights the sunny side.

tokens.name: sticker
tokens.usage: The white cut border around every sticker (plane, star pins). Same in both themes: a sticker is a physical piece of paper.

tokens.name: sticker-fill
tokens.usage: The face of a sticker (the plane body).

tokens.name: sticker-ink
tokens.usage: Outlines and details drawn on a sticker. Stays dark in both themes, because it sits on sticker-fill (11:1).

tokens.name: star-light
tokens.usage: Centre of the star-pin sticker's soft printed shading.

tokens.name: star-edge
tokens.usage: Points of the star-pin sticker's printed shading.

tokens.name: roundel
tokens.usage: The two small wing roundels on the plane sticker. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: sticker-shadow
tokens.usage: Drop shadow under stickers.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px ink outline, 3px away from the control. 11:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Airport codes on the ticket. Always three capitals.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen and section titles, when a screen needs one at all.

styles.name: city
styles.usage: City names under codes, in ink-muted.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Dates and other stamped values, set in capitals.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Distances, times and other small facts, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Code to city name.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between the searching dots; a tag's inner padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Ticket padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between the ticket's code columns and its route.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Ticket padding, left and right.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Ticket distance from the bottom of the screen.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Airport tags.

tokens.name: radius-ticket
tokens.usage: The ticket.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Round sticker buttons and the searching dots.

shadow.note: Hard, offset shadows, like paper cut-outs laid on a desk. No blur on cards.

tokens.name: shadow-ticket
tokens.usage: The ticket.

tokens.name: shadow-tag
tokens.usage: Airport tags and round buttons.

tokens.name: line-hair
tokens.usage: Tag borders, the hover ring.

tokens.name: line-ink
tokens.usage: Ticket border, the ticket's dashed stub divider, sticker outlines.

tokens.name: line-route
tokens.usage: The flight route on the globe.

tokens.name: line-sticker
tokens.usage: The white cut border drawn around a sticker before its fill.

tokens.name: dash-route
tokens.usage: Route dash pattern on the globe (5 5 at ticket scale). Marches forward while a search runs.

tokens.name: dash-ground
tokens.usage: Dotted ground track under a route: round caps turn it into dots.

print.note: The globe is printed, not shaded: halftone screens on paper.

tokens.name: halftone-pitch
tokens.usage: Distance between halftone dots, in CSS pixels.

tokens.name: screen-sea
tokens.usage: Screen angle for the sea.

tokens.name: screen-land
tokens.usage: Screen angle for sage.

tokens.name: screen-moss
tokens.usage: Screen angle for moss.

tokens.name: misregister
tokens.usage: Offset of the moss pass, so the two land inks sit slightly out of register.

tokens.name: graticule-step
tokens.usage: Spacing of latitude and longitude lines.
